subject: Program crashing when more than 4 areas are used

messages.author: af34102c422b7630
messages.subject: Program crashing when more than 4 areas are used
parts:
Hello, dear Nicholas Matzke and all,

My lab colleagues and I have successfully installed and ran BioGeoBears with four areas and less, however, an error message is constantly appearing and the program is crashing when five or more areas are adopted. I assume it's something to do either with my mac config (4Gb ram) or the number of regions. The program manual says that it can perform analyses with up to 10 areas, and I read that A. Pyron managed to use 8 areas succesfully. Could you help me and my colleagues out, please?

Thanks a million,

Alexandre

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Program crashing when more than 4 areas are used
parts:
Hi,

If it works with 4 areas, it should work with 5, unless, say, your geography file only had 4 areas in it.  If you changed the geography file, but didn't give the correct location of the geography file to BioGeoBEARS, that would crash it.

I'm just guessing unless you send the error message.

Cheers,
Nick

messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Program crashing when more than 4 areas are used
parts:
Dear Matzke,

 I pasted the error message I get at the end of calculations. The program starts well and calculates several parameters, and at the end of the "params_table" the program writes

"...successful

Erro em rexpokit::expokit_dgpadm_Qmat(Qmat = Qmat, t = times, transpose_needed) : 
  NA/NaN/Inf em chamada de função externa (argumento 4)
Além disso: Mensagens de aviso perdidas:
1: In optimx.setup(par, fn, gr, hess, lower, upper, method, itnmax,  :
  optimx: No match to available methods
2: In optimx.setup(par, fn, gr, hess, lower, upper, method, itnmax,  :
  Default method when bounds specified is L-BFGS-B to match optim()"

This was performed with 6 runs, and allowing up to 4 areas per species. We tried another run, allowing only 2 areas per species, and the program did not showed any error messages at all.

So this is our problem: how to set up more than 2 areas per taxon in BioGeoBears?

We really appreciate your help.

Best regards

Alex
